title: Action Guardrails: Server-Side Limit Checks vs Prompt Promises

steps.prompt: An autonomous Agentforce agent handles customer refund requests up to $500. To prevent prompt injection and hallucinations from bypassing financial limits, what is the required Well-Architected governance pattern?

options.label: Specify strict financial refund boundaries and negative constraints within the Agent topic instructions
options.distractorAntipattern: Prompt instructions alone are non-deterministic, probabilistic, and susceptible to jailbreaking or hallucination.
options.rationale: Natural language instructions cannot guarantee enforcement; malicious inputs or jailbreaks can persuade the LLM to bypass prompt guidelines.

options.label: Enforce deterministic threshold validation within the backend Apex or Flow Action executing the transaction
options.rationale: Deterministic server-side guardrails in code/Flow ensure business limits cannot be breached regardless of LLM output.

options.label: Configure Einstein Trust Layer safety filters with maximum toxicity and hallucination detection thresholds
options.distractorAntipattern: Trust Layer safety filters identify toxic language or sensitive data leakage, not numerical business logic bypasses.
options.rationale: Toxicity and safety filters detect abusive language and PII, but have no semantic awareness of business thresholds like transaction amounts.
